## Instructions

1. Cut the lard into the flour and salt till it looks like coarse crumbs.
2. Beat the egg in a measuring cup, add the vinegar and fill to one cup with cold water.
3. Stir into the flour with a fork just until it holds together.
4. Divide in four, wrap and chill. Keeps a week in the fridge.

## Notes

"The recipe on the lard box, but Grandma's way."
